note: Generated by tools/boss_data.py build from data/boss/boss_abilities.csv; do not edit.

doc.ability: a = ms after pull before the first cast (0 = no timer); b..c = repeat window ms (0/0 = one-shot); castMs 0 = unknown
doc.phase: rules are checked in order, first match wins; hp rules latch; start always matches and is last

14517.name: High Priestess Jeklik
notes: The bat riders' fire is a game object (spell 19629 summons 177764), so it shows as a trap rather than a spell target.

14599.name: High Priest Thekal
notes: A dead high priest is resurrected after seven seconds unless the other two are dead too; all three must die inside one window.

14515.name: High Priestess Arlokk
notes: Arlokk vanishes for half a minute and returns as a panther; while gone she leaves the mob list.

11382.name: Bloodlord Mandokir
notes: Gaze: the watched player must not move or act; a violation is a Decapitate. Player reports say damage-over-time ticks do not count.

11380.name: Jin'do the Hexxer
notes: Jin'do needs at least two players on his threat list or he resets.

14834.name: Hakkar
notes: Each Aspect is cast only while that high priest is alive; the panel cannot see which priests are dead.

10184.name: Onyxia
notes: Deep Breath is one of eight directional breath spells chosen from aMoveData; it has no timer so the panel shows no next window.
Version 1.18.1 adds a second dragon and Hatchers that are not in this script; they show only as mobs that carry a summoner.

15263.name: The Prophet Skeram
notes: Skeram splits at 75, 50 and 25 percent into himself and two images; the images have 10, 20 and then 50 percent of his health.
Earth Shock is cast only while his victim is out of melee reach; Arcane Explosion only while more players than allowed stand in melee reach.

15516.name: Battleguard Sartura
notes: The next Whirlwind timer starts when the 15 second Whirlwind ends; she goes berserk 10 minutes after the pull.

15510.name: Fankriss the Unyielding
notes: Entangle: three webs, each on a random player, inside a 45 second rotation; hatchlings spawn at the web the player was sent to.
Spawn of Fankriss: the first comes 20-30 s after the pull; each wave is 1-3 spawns 4-8 s apart, the next wave 18-37 s later; each spawn enrages after 15, 20 or 25 s.

15276.name: Emperor Vek'lor
notes: Vek'lor takes no physical damage and Vek'nilash no spell damage; both teleport to swap places every 30-40 s.

15589.name: Eye of C'Thun
notes: The first three Eye Beams go to the puller, then to random targets; Dark Glare starts 45 s after the beam phase begins and lasts 38 s, and the next beam phase follows 1 s after it ends.

15727.name: C'Thun
notes: Phase 2: the first stomach grab comes 18 s minus the 3.25 s grab after he emerges, then every 10 s; killing both Flesh Tentacles in the stomach weakens him for 45 s.

9018.name: High Interrogator Gerstahn
notes: Shadow Word: Pain and Mana Burn both go to a random attacker, not the tank.

9319.name: Houndmaster Grebmar
notes: Houndmaster Grebmar has no boss script: generic_spell_ai casts the three spells in his creature_template slots on a 10-20 s repeat with a first cast at the pull, skips a spell while its aura is up and retries a failed cast in 0.5 s, so the panel gets no script timer from them.

9016.name: Bael'Gar
notes: Bael'Gar has no boss script: four EventAI HP events cast 13895 at 82, 62, 42 and 22 percent, each a cast-time spell at a random attacker that summons one Spawn of Bael'Gar where that player stands; the cast is not kickable (preventionType 0) and the timer columns are 0 because the events are HP thresholds.

9033.name: General Angerforge
notes: The first Sunder is 5-10 s after the pull; the alarm fires as soon as he drops below 30 percent and again every 3 minutes while he stays below it, summoning eight Anvilrage Reservists and two Anvilrage Medics at the m_aAddspawnLocs points for 30 s.

8983.name: Golem Lord Argelmach
notes: Lightning Shield is re-applied whenever it is missing; its 15 s timer only limits the retry after the aura drops, and his ai_name EventAI never runs because the script_name npc_golem_lord_argelmach wins.
On aggro he walks to 846.801, 16.281, -53.640 and pulls the living Ragereaver Golems and Wrath Hammer Constructs within 80 yd onto his current victim.

9017.name: Lord Incendius
notes: Lord Incendius has no script, no EventAI row and no spell in this core: ai_name and script_name are both empty and all four creature_template spell slots are 0, so the default CreatureAI only melees.

9056.name: Fineous Darkvire
notes: Fineous Darkvire has no boss script: EventAI casts Devotion Aura on himself after 1 s and every 4 minutes, Holy Strike at his current target every 6-8.5 s while it is within 5 yd (first at the pull), Holy Light on himself at 60 and again at 40 percent, and Seal of Reckoning at 20 percent; Holy Light is the only kickable cast.

9156.name: Ambassador Flamelash
notes: Ambassador Flamelash has no boss script: his EventAI only switches the instance encounter, and the instance opens the seven dwarf runes and summons a Burning Spirit at each one every 15-30 s (5 s for the first), up to 30, which follow him. He casts 14744 on himself whenever a spirit's 13489 hits him.

9938.name: Magmus
notes: War Stomp starts below 51 percent with a timer of 0, so the first one lands on the next update; Fiery Burst is a 10 yd area at his current victim.

9019.name: Emperor Dagran Thaurissan
notes: Hand of Thaurissan is cast only while a player other than the top threat is alive; its first window is 5-7.5 s and a failed cast leaves the timer at 0 and retries every update.
Princess Moira Bronzebeard 8929 fights with him, heals him with 15586 whenever he is not at full health and turns friendly when he dies; she is an add row here, not a block of this table.
Ironfoe 15642 is defined in his script but never cast.

9196.name: Highlord Omokk
notes: He evades when pulled by a pet or when his z leaves 25 to 50; the enrage his comment asks about is not cast.

9236.name: Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin
notes: Hex adds 15 s to its own timer after a successful cast instead of resetting it; he evades when pulled by a pet or when his z leaves 0 to 30.

9237.name: War Master Voone
notes: Throw Axe stops after the second hit: the second applies the passive 16076 and the loop ends; the first throw is 10-30 s after the pull and repeats are 5-15 s.

10596.name: Mother Smolderweb
notes: Mother Smolderweb's creature_template ai_name is EventAI and its script_name is empty, so boss_mother_smolderweb.cpp never runs: she does not crystallize or summon Spire Spiderlings in this core. Her only cast is EventAI 1059603, Mother's Milk every 7-15 s while the current victim lacks it; the action picks a random attacker and the aura then lands around her.

9736.name: Quartermaster Zigris
notes: She evades when pulled by a pet or when her z is below 50; Hooked Net 15609 and the Healing Potion 15504 are declared in the script but never cast.

10220.name: Halycon
notes: Gizrul the Slavener spawns when she dies through a direct SummonCreature at -167.58, -382.41, 64.401 and sets his home to -172.633, -324.253, 64.401; no spell is involved.

9568.name: Overlord Wyrmthalak
notes: Below 51 percent he summons one Spirestone Warlord and one Smoldertooth Berserker once, at the two afLocations points; he evades when pulled by a pet or when his z leaves 72 to 100.
